name: oeis-mcp-server
description: Identify integer sequences by terms, search the OEIS, read formulas, programs, b-files, cross-refs.

interface.shortDescription: Identify integer sequences by terms, search the OEIS, read formulas, programs, b-files, cross-refs.
interface.longDescription: Look up integer sequences in the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS). Identify an unknown sequence from a run of observed terms, with the index where the run begins in each match, or search with OEIS's own query syntax: words, quoted phrases, and prefixes such as keyword:, author:, and formula:. Read an entry by A-number with its formulas, generating functions, programs, comments, and references; pull extended terms from its b-file as exact decimal strings; and list the sequences it cross-references or that mention it. A reference tool decodes keyword flags, search syntax, and offsets. Requests to oeis.org are paced to one every 10 seconds and cached. No API key required; OEIS content is CC BY-SA 4.0, and every record carries its oeis.org URL for attribution.
